node.title: KoalaBear F04 cubic/J11 logarithmic-denominator branch exclusion
node.closure: exact named-localized exclusion of both symmetric denominator unions on R02 and R20
node.statement: Pairing the two degree-7 and the two degree-11 nonnamed logarithmic-denominator factors under c<->d gives two symmetric union equations. After descent to (x,s,p,w), V-nonzero reconstruction w=-U/V, and exact removal of transported named factors, their essential equations have degrees 25 and 60 on F04-R02 and degrees 28 and 62 on F04-R20. Intersecting each equation with the surviving cubic q-slice factor, the two remaining q-slice rows, and the full-J J11 factor gives four exact deployed-prime ideals. In all four, the square-free transported named localizer reduces to zero. Therefore every logarithmic-denominator-zero branch is empty over the deployed field and all its extensions. Only the guarded degree-67 logarithmic numerator branch remains on the F04 cubic/J11 route.
